Green Herb Soup (Gründonnerstagssuppe)

Served at: Maundy Thursday

Serves 4-6Prep 20 minCook 30 min

This traditional Green Herb Soup, known as Gründonnerstagssuppe in German, is a customary dish for Maundy Thursday. Its vibrant green color symbolizes new life and the coming spring, while its simple, meatless preparation aligns with the Lenten observance before Easter. It's a comforting and nourishing soup, perfect for a reflective meal.

Ingredients

  • 1 tablespoon olive oil (15 mL)
  • 1 small yellow onion, finely chopped
  • 1 clove garlic, minced
  • 2 medium potatoes, peeled and diced (about 1 lb / 450 g)
  • 4 cups vegetable broth (1 liter)
  • 1 cup mixed fresh green herbs, finely chopped (e.g., parsley, chives, dill, sorrel, spinach, watercress) (about 25 g)
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream or crème fraîche (120 mL) (optional)
  • 1/4 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg
  • Salt to taste
  • Freshly ground black pepper to taste

Method

  1. Heat the olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium heat.
  2. Add the finely chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5-7 minutes.
  3. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant.
  4. Add the diced potatoes and vegetable broth to the pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the potatoes are very tender.
  5. Remove the pot from the heat. Add the mixed fresh green herbs to the soup.
  6. Using an immersion blender, carefully blend the soup until smooth. Alternatively, transfer the soup in batches to a regular blender and blend until smooth, then return to the pot.
  7. Stir in the heavy cream or crème fraîche, if using. Add the freshly grated nutmeg.
  8. Season the soup with salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste. Heat gently for a few more minutes, but do not boil after adding cream.
  9. Serve hot, garnished with a few fresh herb sprigs if desired.

Tips

  • For the best flavor, use a variety of fresh, tender green herbs. Avoid woody herbs like rosemary or thyme for this recipe.
  • To make this soup vegan, simply omit the heavy cream or crème fraîche, or substitute with a plant-based cream alternative.
  • Serve with a dollop of sour cream or a sprinkle of toasted croutons for added texture and richness.
